title: Cargo target-sibling watcher refusals do not name the change's modification and arrival times
outcome: A gate refusal caused by a Cargo temporary target sibling (a pending candidate judged at settlement, a reported-end carry's sibling, or candidate overflow) names the sibling change's modification time and when its notification reached the host, as other watcher refusals do. The holder can then tell a late report from a write during the run.
acceptance: Cargo target-sibling watcher refusals do not name the change's modification and arrival times is done
